newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * German President Roman Herzog said Germany would support Romania's reforms and its efforts to integrate into European institutions.
* Former French President Valery Giscard D'Estaign congratulated newly elected president Constantinescu.
* The Turkish ambassador to Bucharest assessed Romania's elections as fair and democratic.
* Designated premier Victor Ciorbea joined U.S. ambassador Alfred Moses at ceremony presenting a new U.S. aid programme to improve sanitatary conditions in Bucharest's schools.
* Victor Surdu, head of the Democratic Agrarian party hailed the designation of Ciorbea as prime minister. He said his party would back the new government.
* The upper house, the Senate, met in its last session to evaluate activity over past four years.
* Senate to meet on Friday to form commission to validate new MPs.

* Outgoing Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu said during his mandate Romania had boosted its efforts to join the European Union and NATO. Melescanu told reporters Romania's integration into EU and NATO should remain teh main goals of the country's foreign policy. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
